rule.name: SpringCsrfDisabled
rule.message: Keep CSRF protection on for session-based security. Turn it off only for a stateless API, in the same filter chain: SessionCreationPolicy.STATELESS or a NullSecurityContextRepository on servlet security, NoOpServerSecurityContextRepository on WebFlux, or oauth2ResourceServer with jwt or opaqueToken and every login form disabled.
